These two creatures are the stuff of (very bizarre) dreams. One of them tries very little to avoid confrontation but is incredibly tough, whereas the other is a nuisance to chase down yet can be killed with a couple of blows.

Quest: Dream Mentor

Combat: One very tough, one tricky to reach. They both attack with melee, but you'll have Cyrisus with you to help out a bit.
